import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';

test('the watchdog reads unit states from the real service manager', async () => {
  for (const u of ['worklane.service', 'worklane-update.timer']) {
    const r = spawnSync('systemctl', ['is-active', u]);
    if (u.endsWith('.timer')) continue;
    assert.ok(r);
  }
});
test('if last, not taken', async () => {
  const r = spawnSync('systemctl', ['--version']);
  if (r.status === 12345) {
    assert.fail('x');
  }
});
test('try last', async () => {
  try {
    assert.ok(spawnSync('systemctl', ['--version']));
  } finally {
    assert.ok(true);
  }
});
